newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $562 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $562 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, July 16 were expected to total $562 billion in 23 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $418 million in nine sales, with a $132 million United Nations Development, N.Y., offering through Goldman, Sachs & Co., topping the list.

On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $144 million are scheduled. A $41 million Texas Public Faclities Authority offering at 1130 EDT is the largest. An additional six sales totaling $58 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
